item.title: Acquisition establishes Canadian terminal operator as North America’s market leader
item.description: Cando Rail & Terminals of Canada has acquired Savage Rail of the USA, making it a market leader in first- and last-mile rail operating services.

item.title: Agreement will see steam locomotive 30120 return to steam
item.description: The 563 Locomotive Group has announced the next stage in its project to return London & South Western Railway T9 Class 4-4-0 steam locomotive No. 120 to steam.

item.title: Passengers save millions as rail fare freeze starts
item.description: The UK Government says that passengers are now benefitting from the freeze on rail fares for the first time in 30 years. It is expected…

item.title: 25 Years On: Remembering the Selby Rail Tragedy
item.description: On Saturday, 28 February, around 200 people gathered at Selby Abbey to honour the ten lives lost and the many others forever changed in the Selby rail disaster, marking 25 years since one of the UK's most devastating rail disasters.

item.title: St David’s Day celebrated in style at Llangollen and Corwen Railway
item.description: Llangollen and Corwen Railway has marked St David's Day in style with steam, song, and community spirit. The heritage Dee Valley line welcomed passengers for heritage steam journeys between Llangollen and Corwen, along with Welsh music, bilingual announcements, and a speciality menu.

item.title: Austin’s dream day on the rails at Liverpool Street
item.description: Austin, an eight-year-old train enthusiast from Suffolk, had a day to remember at Liverpool Street station thanks to Network Rail Anglia. His passion for trains began during the 2020 lockdown, watching them from his back garden. As restrictions eased, his adventures expanded nationwide, shared with thousands of followers via his dad’s social accounts, Austin’s Rail Adventures.

item.title: Maritime Transport unveils major rail logistics hub in Northampton
item.description: Maritime Transport, the UK’s leading integrated road and rail freight provider, has officially opened its Strategic Rail Freight Interchange (SRFI) at SEGRO Logistics Park Northampton.

item.title: London Euston to welcome upgrades for passengers this spring
item.description: Passengers at London Euston are set to enjoy a host of improvements this spring as Network Rail continues its upgrade programme at one of the UK's busiest stations.

item.title: A journey through the past, present and future with South Eastern Railway
item.description: South Eastern Railway has announced that on Wednesday, 11 March, at One Birdcage Walk, Central London, rail enthusiasts and history buffs alike are invited to a one-off event celebrating two centuries of passenger rail travel.

item.title: West Yorkshire railway station transformed in £7.8M upgrade
item.description: Passengers at Menston station can now enjoy fully accessible, step‑free travel following a £7.8 million upgrade. An opening ceremony celebrated improvements delivered under the Government’s Access for All programme.
